descriptionPlain:
Role Overview
The Accountant will support procurement and accounts payable operations for Match Group APAC, with a focus on purchase order management, supplier invoice processing, accruals, expense review, and account reconciliation.
This role will work closely with Accounting, Procurement, business stakeholders, and vendors to ensure purchase orders and invoices are processed accurately, timely, and in compliance with internal policies, SOX controls, and applicable accounting standards. The position primarily supports the Korea entity and contributes to month-end closing, financial accuracy, and process improvement initiatives.
description:
Role Overview

The Accountant will support procurement and accounts payable operations for Match Group APAC, with a focus on purchase order management, supplier invoice processing, accruals, expense review, and account reconciliation.

This role will work closely with Accounting, Procurement, business stakeholders, and vendors to ensure purchase orders and invoices are processed accurately, timely, and in compliance with internal policies, SOX controls, and applicable accounting standards. The position primarily supports the Korea entity and contributes to month-end closing, financial accuracy, and process improvement initiatives.

lists.content:
• Purchase Order Management

  • Create, review, and monitor purchase orders for marketing and operational expenses.

  • Ensure accurate vendor information, GL coding, cost center allocation, budget alignment, and supporting documentation.

  • Handle manual PO creation for non-standard or ad-hoc procurement needs.

  • Monitor open POs and follow up on pending receipts, unused balances, or required updates.

  • Ensure compliance with internal procurement policies and approval requirements.

  • AP Invoice Processing

  • Process supplier invoices for APAC entities, primarily Korea and Japan.

  • Validate invoices against POs, contracts, approvals, and supporting documents.

  • Ensure accurate invoice coding, cost center allocation, tax treatment, and accounting classification.

  • Coordinate with vendors and internal stakeholders to resolve invoice discrepancies and payment issues.

  • Review local tax treatment, including Korean VAT and Japanese Consumption Tax where applicable.

  • Accruals, Reconciliation, and Closing Support

  • Review and record receipt accruals and manual accruals for marketing and operational expenses.

  • Validate goods or services received but not yet invoiced with business teams.

  • Perform AP, procurement, marketing, OPEX, and related account reconciliations.

  • Support month-end closing activities, including accrual review, invoice cut-off checks, and expense analysis.

  • Prepare supporting documentation for internal and external audit requests.

  • Process Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve PO, AP, accrual, and reconciliation processes.

  • Participate in system implementation, automation, and process improvement initiatives.

  • Collaborate with regional and global teams to drive standardization and best practices.

  • Support ad hoc projects as assigned by management.

• Minimum 2 years of experience in Accounts Payable, procurement operations, accounting, or finance operations.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.

  • Understanding of PO management, AP invoice processing, accrual accounting, and account reconciliation.

  • Knowledge of K-IFRS, US GAAP, SOX controls, Korean VAT, or Japanese Consumption Tax is preferred.

  • Experience with ERP or finance systems such as Workday, Oracle, SAP, OneStream, or similar tools is a plus.

  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and/or Google Sheets.

  • Strong communication skills in Korean and English.

  • Business-level Japanese is a plus.

  • Detail-oriented, analytical, organized, and able to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

• Legal Entity: Hyperconnect

  • Brand/Department: Match Group APAC Accounting

  • Reporting to: Sr. Manager, Accounting

  • Location: Seoul, Korea – Hybrid Working Style

  • Probation Period: 3 months

#Hinge
descriptionPlain:
Hinge is the dating app designed to be deleted

In today's digital world, finding genuine relationships is tougher than ever. At Hinge, we’re on a mission to inspire intimate connection to create a less lonely world. We’re obsessed with understanding our users’ behaviors to help them find love, and our success is defined by one simple metric– setting up great dates. With millions of users across the globe, we’ve become the most trusted way to find a relationship, for all.


About the Role
 
As a key member of our Android team, you will play a vital role in developing and maintaining the Hinge Android mobile application. Your focus will be on implementing new product features, fixing issues, and improving the mobile application user experience. All while leveraging the latest Android tools such as Kotlin, jetpack compose, coroutines, room, hilt and many more. Collaborating within a cross-disciplinary team, including product managers, technical project managers, designers, data engineers, backend engineers, and QA specialists, you will work closely with the Tech Lead and peers to advance our product and contribute to our engineering community. This role offers the opportunity to do high-impact work, directly contributing to a consumer mobile application used by millions. Over time you can expect to grow into an independent, capable, and confident Android developer.

lists.content:
• Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration: Work closely with a diverse team of developers, designers, and product managers to build features that prioritize high quality and user engagement.
  • Kotlin Proficiency: Develop and continuously enhance your understanding of Kotlin fundamentals, applying them to create efficient and effective solutions.
  • Android Expertise: Gain a thorough understanding of Android development principles and design patterns, applying them to build intuitive and user-friendly applications.
  • Issue Resolution: Triage, debug, and effectively resolve software issues, ensuring the stability and performance of our application.
  • Codebase Stewardship: Actively contribute to the long-term health and evolution of the codebase, implementing best practices and innovative solutions.
  • Code Reviews: Regularly perform code reviews, providing constructive feedback to peers to foster a culture of excellence and continuous improvement.
  • Active Team Participation: Engage actively in team ceremonies such as stand-ups, planning sessions, and retrospectives to ensure alignment and promote agile methodologies.
  • Effective Communication: Maintain clear and positive communication with team members and other departments, supporting an empowering and inclusive team environment.

• Professional Android Development Experience: You have 3-5 years of experience in Android development, demonstrating the ability to design and implement mobile applications effectively.
  • Google Play Publication: You have experience publishing at least one application on the Google Play Store, showcasing your understanding of the deployment process and maintaining a production application.
  • Proficiency in Kotlin and Android SDKs: You are proficient in Kotlin, which is strongly preferred, and have a good understanding of Android SDKs and frameworks. Experience with Java in the context of Android development is also beneficial.
  • Solid Software Development Fundamentals: You possess a good foundation in software development principles and are capable of creating efficient and maintainable code.
  • Strong Communication Skills: You are able to communicate clearly and effectively, facilitating productive collaborations within technical and non-technical teams.
  • Ownership and Quality Focus: You take pride in your work and are committed to creating high-quality user experiences, demonstrating attention to detail and a user-centric approach to application development.

descriptionPlain:
- Legal Entity: Hyperconnect
- Brand: Tinder
 
 
About Tinder
 
Tinder connects people. 
With tens of millions of users and a presence in nearly every country on Earth, our reach is expansive—and growing fast.
 
The Globalization team sits within Product Operations and plays a critical role in shaping how we connect with people worldwide. We enable culturally relevant, hyper-localized experiences by partnering across product, design, content, and marketing to ensure Tinder resonates across borders and languages.
 
 
About the Role
 
We’re looking for an experienced and strategically minded Senior Localization Program Manager to drive Tinder’s localization efforts across APAC.
 
Reporting to the Sr. Manager of Globalization & International Growth, this role will work closely with another Program Manager to operationalize the team’s global strategy within the region — ensuring our products, content, and campaigns are not just translated, but truly built for local relevance and impact.
 
You’ll serve as a regional program lead, connecting cross-functional partners across Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Design to integrate localization early in development, optimize workflows, and surface insights that inform global decisions.
 
This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of program management, technical localization, and cultural strategy, and who can scale processes across multiple markets while staying attuned to local nuance.

lists.content:
• Drive regional localization execution and strategy alignment: Own the end-to-end localization program for APAC, translating global strategy into regional priorities and scalable programs.
  • Act as a regional thought partner: Collaborate with the Sr. Manager of Globalization and the broader Globalization team to shape initiatives that advance Tinder’s global readiness and user experience.
  • Cross-functional leadership: Build strong relationships with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Design, and Data to integrate localization into roadmaps and launch cycles, influencing decisions with regional insights.
  • Partner with regional Marketing leads and the VP of APAC Marketing to support Go-To-Market Asia efforts—ensuring on-time delivery of localized assets, efficient production workflows, and seamless execution of high-impact campaigns across markets.
  • Optimize localization operations: Assess and refine workflows, tools, and automation (TMS, CAT, QA automation, connectors) to enhance efficiency, transparency, and quality.
  • Support internationalization efforts: Partner with engineering to identify and address i18n issues, ensuring scalability and long-term product readiness across languages.
  • Program governance: Establish and track KPIs to measure localization performance, cost efficiency, and quality outcomes.
  • Vendor and resource management: Oversee localization vendors and freelance linguists, driving accountability, innovation, and high-quality output.
  • Mentorship and enablement: Collaborate closely with Language Managers and other Program Managers to ensure alignment, mentorship, and consistent process execution across regions.
  • Cultural intelligence: Stay ahead of cultural trends, linguistic shifts, and user behaviors across APAC markets to guide creative and product decisions.
    •

• 5+ years of experience in localization program management, international operations, or a related function within a tech, product, or global brand environment.
  • Proven success managing complex, multi-market localization programs across APAC.
  • Deep understanding of localization technology ecosystems (TMS, CAT, QA automation) and internationalization fundamentals.
  • Strong program management skills — from scoping and prioritization to stakeholder communication and risk mitigation.
  • Experience influencing product and marketing decisions through data, insights, and user empathy.
  • Excellent cross-functional communication skills and a collaborative mindset; comfortable working across technical and creative teams.
  • Self-starter with strong ownership, adaptability, and attention to detail.
  • Fluent in English
    •

• Experience localizing mobile apps or digital platforms, particularly in dating, social, or lifestyle categories.
  • Familiarity with Tinder’s tone, brand voice, and youth culture positioning.
  • Technical literacy in APIs, localization connectors, or automation scripting.
  • Fluency in at least one APAC language (e.g., Japanese, Korean, Thai, Vietnamese, Hindi, etc.).
  • Experience supporting go-to-market or regional marketing campaigns across diverse APAC markets.

#Meetic
descriptionPlain:
At Meetic, a Match Group company, we have been pioneering online dating for over 20 years, leveraging our legacy to reinvent how people meet, connect, and build meaningful relationships across Europe and beyond. 
As part of Match Group, we manage a diverse portfolio of brands, from iconic names like Meetic, Match, Lexa, and LoveScout24 to tailored experiences for singles over 50, OurTime, DisonsDemain, Zweisam, and single parents, Even and Stir. 

Our teams design, build, and scale platforms across 20+ countries and 18 languages, ensuring every single finds the right match for their lifestyle and lifestages. We also drive growth for other Match Group brands like The League, OkCupid, Archer, Salams, and Plenty Of Fish, expanding our impact worldwide.

When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL). We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL 3 days / week in our office, 53 rue de Chateaudun, 75009 Paris.


Role overview :

As an Online Acquisition Apprentice, you’ll support the team in accelerating paid growth across our global portfolio of dating apps. Working closely with both the creative team and media partners, you’ll help develop and optimize acquisition strategies, contribute to campaign planning and performance analysis, and gain hands-on experience in traffic management in a dynamic, data-driven marketing environment. This role offers a unique opportunity to learn how online acquisition drives business impact at scale.

How you’ll make an impact:
Help grow online acquisition across multiple dating apps and markets.
Share creative feedback and reports to improve ad performance.
Spot and launch new media partners to expand reach.
 
We could be a match if:
You are a Bachelor's or Master's student seeking an apprenticeship, ideally with a 3-weeks-in-company / 1-week-at-school schedule, but we warmly welcome other formats.
You have hands-on experience with Meta Ads and Google Ads platforms. Affiliation will be a plus.
You’re curious, proactive, rigorous, and open-minded.
You’re comfortable working with Excel or Google Sheets.
You enjoy collaborating with creative, tracking, and media partner teams.
Your familiarity with AI / LLM tools is a plus.
You are fluent in English, both written and spoken.

What’s the team like?
You’ll report to a Team Lead Online Marketing and join a collaborative, data-driven and multicultural team.
You will work closely with the rest of the acquisition team with different expertise, and the creative teams. 
 
Interview Process:
A first 30 min Zoom conversation with Fatima-Ezzahra Abidi (Talent Acquisition Specialist).
A 60 onsite meeting with Yanjun Shi (Team Lead Online Marketing) including a case study.
A 60 min onsite or Zoom interview with Florent Maucourt (Sr. Online Marketing Manager) and Céline Ben Haddou (People Business Partner).

As part of Match Group, we manage a diverse portfolio of brands, from iconic names like Meetic, Match, Lexa, and LoveScout24 to tailored experiences for singles over 50, OurTime, DisonsDemain, Zweisam, and single parents, Even and Stir. 

Our teams design, build, and scale platforms across 20+ countries and 18 languages, ensuring every single finds the right match for their lifestyle and lifestages. We also drive growth for other Match Group brands like The League, OkCupid, Archer, Salams, and Plenty Of Fish, expanding our impact worldwide.

When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL). We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL 3 days / week in our office, 53 rue de Chateaudun, 75009 Paris.
descriptionBody:
Role overview :


As an Online Acquisition Apprentice, you’ll support the team in accelerating paid growth across our global portfolio of dating apps. Working closely with both the creative team and media partners, you’ll help develop and optimize acquisition strategies, contribute to campaign planning and performance analysis, and gain hands-on experience in traffic management in a dynamic, data-driven marketing environment. This role offers a unique opportunity to learn how online acquisition drives business impact at scale.

How you’ll make an impact:

  • Help grow online acquisition across multiple dating apps and markets.
  • Share creative feedback and reports to improve ad performance.
  • Spot and launch new media partners to expand reach.

 

We could be a match if:

  • You are a Bachelor's or Master's student seeking an apprenticeship, ideally with a 3-weeks-in-company / 1-week-at-school schedule, but we warmly welcome other formats.
  • You have hands-on experience with Meta Ads and Google Ads platforms. Affiliation will be a plus.
  • You’re curious, proactive, rigorous, and open-minded.
  • You’re comfortable working with Excel or Google Sheets.
  • You enjoy collaborating with creative, tracking, and media partner teams.
  • Your familiarity with AI / LLM tools is a plus.
  • You are fluent in English, both written and spoken.


What’s the team like?

  • You’ll report to a Team Lead Online Marketing and join a collaborative, data-driven and multicultural team.
  • You will work closely with the rest of the acquisition team with different expertise, and the creative teams. 

 

Interview Process:

  • A first 30 min Zoom conversation with Fatima-Ezzahra Abidi (Talent Acquisition Specialist).
  • A 60 onsite meeting with Yanjun Shi (Team Lead Online Marketing) including a case study.
  • A 60 min onsite or Zoom interview with Florent Maucourt (Sr. Online Marketing Manager) and Céline Ben Haddou (People Business Partner).

additionalPlain:
Our Values
Take the Lead: We don't ghost our work or each other. Just as users don't leave their matches hanging, we don't let each other down.
Move Fast: We have a bias for action and urgency. Something that could be done tomorrow would be better if done today.
Better Together: We keep connection at the heart of dating and at the heart of how we work. Just as our users are better when they connect with others, so are we when we collaborate.
Real Talk: We say the hard thing the human way. Just as we ask our users to behave with kindness and candor in our community, we expect all of us to do the same.
Safety First: We act with integrity, transparency, and consistency so people feel safe—whether they're swiping, matching, or working alongside us.
Spark Fun: We have fun to unlock creativity, fuel innovation, and help us build better experiences for daters.

Match Group is seeking an Associate Manager of Culture & Content to lead social, creators, partnerships, and content across a portfolio of Match Group brands. Sitting within the Everyone & Everywhere portfolio, this role brings each brand's strategy to life through culturally relevant storytelling, authentic collaborations, and social engagement.

Reporting to the Director of Culture & Content, this person will own approximately 2–3 brands while serving as the primary day-to-day partner out of our Los Angeles office.

lists.content:
• Spot emerging trends, communities, creators, and behaviors across audiences and cultures, and turn them into actionable opportunities, including identifying the right moments and spaces for brands to authentically join cultural conversations.

  • Develop always-on and campaign plans with cross-functional and agency partners – driving the creative bar and ensuring integrated execution across functions

  • Own the full content lifecycle for quick-turn, organic content often with little to no outside production support: ideation, concepting, scripting/storyboarding, filming/content capture, and editing across short-form video and static formats

  • Adapt and repurpose influencer, UGC, campaign, and IRL activation footage into platform-native content in near real time

  • Translate organic to paid content by working with media, brand, and creative teams to ensure a consistent flow of content into our paid flywheel

  • Own day-to-day social planning and publishing across all social platforms, ensuring content reflects platform best practices and audience expectations

  • Partner with community management to foster meaningful conversations and help evolve each brand’s voice across owned channels

  • Protect brand trust through social monitoring, triaging timely interactions, and execuing escalation protocols with cross-functional partners

  • Protect brand trust through timely and accurate responses

• Build creator rosters aligned with each brand’s audience

  • Coordinate creator and partner campaign execution, approvals, timelines, and performance tracking

  • Nurture and support long-term relationships that strengthen brand affinity

  • Execute partnerships and IRL activations that expand relevance, credibility, reach, and conversation

  • Lead the connected 360 plan across social, community, creators, partnerships, experiences, and paid amplification.

• Collaborate with brand, insights, creative, PR, product, growth, and analytics

  • Support agency partners and external vendors throughout campaign development

  • Partner with analytics and growth teams to analyze results and identify actionable learnings

  • Recommend optimizations that improve engagement, creator performance, and business outcomes

  • Expected to measure and track KPIs across content and community performance, including engagement quality, organic and creator performance, sentiment, share of voice, content efficiency, and audience participation.

• 3-5 years of experience in brand, social, cultural marketing, partnerships, creator marketing, or adjacent disciplines

  • Strong understanding of social-first storytelling and platform-native creative

  • Demonstrated, hands-on content creation skills are required for this role — you must be able to independently concept, shoot, and edit content (proficiency with tools like CapCut, Premiere, Figma, or equivalent is expected)

  • A portfolio or reel showing native social content you've personally created and edited (not just directed or briefed)

  • Deep understanding of major and emerging platforms, distinct community dynamics per channel, and the agility to pivot strategic approaches

  • Proven success building culturally relevant programs that generate conversation, engagement, and brand love

  • Strong consumer instinct and cultural empathy across different audiences, communities, and subcultures

  • Excellent communication and project management skills

  • Ability to balance multiple brands and competing priorities

  • Strong creative instincts, editorial judgment, and ability to move quickly on opportunity.

  • Experience managing cross-functional teams and external partners from idea through execution and measurement.

  • Passion for pop culture, digital communities, and emerging consumer trends.

salaryDescription: The salary range for this position is $95,000 - $110,000. Factors such as scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/training, job-related skills, internal peer equity, as well as market and business considerations may influence base pay offered. This salary range is reflective of a position based in Los Angeles, CA. This salary will be subject to a geographic adjustment (according to a specific city and state), if an authorization is granted to work outside of the location listed in this posting.
